name: real_revision_application_cost
description: Apply the four real BPS releases of the frozen province panel to every treatment, one arrival at a time, and measure what each real revision costs that treatment in statement time, in stored rows and in bytes.

relation_to_h11.same_mechanisms: the frozen treatment write mechanisms, with the maintenance each treatment requires applied per arrival
relation_to_h11.difference: H11 measures one synthetic revision of a controlled size on top of the finished panel; H12 measures the four real releases that build that panel, so the revisions are the ones BPS actually published
relation_to_h11.expected_final_state: the state after the fourth arrival must equal the H11 baseline expectations

workload.real_revision_evidence: results/processed/h11-b1-state-catalog.csv records, per arrival, the rows that arrive, the rows they overwrite and how many of those overwrites change the published value

protocol.execution: serial, one operator, no concurrent treatment run and no other workload on the node
protocol.cycle: DROP TABLE ... PURGE for every table, recreate them, then one timed Spark SQL session per treatment that applies arrival 1 to 4 in order

per_arrival.B0: MERGE the arriving vintage into the current table, then expire_snapshots down to one
per_arrival.B1: INSERT OVERWRITE every state up to this arrival, retaining one Iceberg snapshot per release
per_arrival.B2: INSERT OVERWRITE the selection recomputed over the vintages that have arrived, then expire_snapshots down to one
per_arrival.B3: INSERT the arriving vintage into the append-only store, MERGE the cells its lineage edges mark dirty into the serving table, then expire_snapshots down to one on both tables

protocol.maintenance_note: maintenance runs per arrival, exactly as it does per injected revision in H10B and H11, so the two measurements are comparable

timing.boundary: in-session Spark SQL statement time reported by the Spark SQL CLI; JVM startup, catalog warm-up and view creation are excluded from the treatment cost
timing.aggregation: median over repetitions, reported with the minimum and maximum
timing.claim_limit: comparative between treatments on the declared 2 vCPU VM at panel scale; never a performance, throughput or scalability claim

footprint.per_arrival: bytes of the data files and manifests the table metadata still references after that arrival
footprint.final_check: the MinIO listing of every table location after the last arrival, with every metadata-referenced object present at the size metadata records

measurement_boundary.synthetic_revisions: none; the injected sweep stays with H11

invariants: the panel payload still matches the checksums of its manifest
the catalog is persistent and the working tree is clean before any measurement starts
every arrival leaves the row, cell and snapshot counts the panel state implies
the state after the fourth arrival equals the H11 baseline expectations for every treatment
every metadata-referenced object exists in MinIO with the size recorded in metadata
all repetitions are reported and aggregation happens only after row-level checks
timing is reported only for the declared environment and only as a comparison between treatments
